senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. מוּץ) to press, suck; to drain.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 19:2">Sabb. XIX, 2</cite> <he>ומוֹצְצִין</he> and compress the blood-vessels of the wound by sucking.
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 9:3">Par. IX, 3</cite> <he>שהיא מוֹצֶצֶת</he> she (the dove) sips (and lets no water out of her mouth again).

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 5:9">Tosef. Sot. V, 9</cite> <he>נוטלו ומוֹצְצוֹ ואוכל וכ׳</he> he takes out the fly and sucks it out and eats the dish; Y. ib. I, 17ᵃ bot.; <cite ref="Gittin 90a">Gitt. 90ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 15:4">Lev. R. s. 15</cite> <he>לא שהוא מוצץ וכ׳</he> not that the dry sponge drains the wound, but it protects it.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:24">Deut. R. s. 2</cite> <he>אין לך טבעת מוֹץ אותה ומות</he> hast thou not a ring (containing poison)? Suck it and die; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:10">Cant. R. to III, 10</cite> <he>מוצצת באש</he>, read: <he>מוּצֶתֶת</he>, v. <cite ref="J00552"><he>יָצַת</he></cite>.]
